entries.b53807df8387f6d3: This is the main business handled by the company and its overseas subsidiary, Be UNIQUE Inc. It carries out resident development support, which places IT engineers at client sites under dispatch, quasi-mandate and work contracts; contracted development of systems; and operation and maintenance of systems and software under work contracts. It also sells and introduces products such as Google Workspace and UM SaaS Cloud, and others, and acts as a sales agent for packaged software. It provides services to client companies across a wide range of industries, such as information and communications, finance and insurance, and services and others, without depending on any specific industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,546 million. Customers accounting for 10% or more of revenue are Arudīto Co., Ltd. (¥766 million) and Itochu Techno-Solutions Corporation (¥600 million).

It operates three Type B Continuous Employment Support Facilities specializing in IT skills (Dejirumi Sapporo Higashi, TeCREA Chitose and Dejirumi Sapporo Nishi), providing work opportunities, production activities, and training and support to improve the knowledge and abilities needed for work, for people who have difficulty working under employment contracts with general companies and others.
